text: Particle life between creatures: species attract and repel each other
description: Research 2026-11-24 (Particle Life, Ventrella's Clusters): a small signed matrix of attraction between species, a repulsive core at short range (keeps clusters from collapsing), nothing at long range, gives whole ecologies from a few numbers; asymmetric matrices chase and orbit. Here: each creature is a species; apply the matrix between body centres (count^2, negligible) as a force on all of a body's particles, or per particle via a spatial grid. Creatures would court, chase, school and scatter instead of following fixed swim paths; the player could be a species too.
